description: Prepare an audience-specific internal operating communication.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Pinned upstream modules copied with licenses and exact commit identities; see references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json
provenance.license: See per-source upstream license copies and manifest

routing.when_to_use: Prepare an audience-specific internal operating communication.
when_not_to_use: A different task requires its own skill
exclusion_rules: Missing facts block the affected conclusion, not harmless drafting
ambiguity_rules: Read existing authorized evidence first; ask only material unanswered questions

required_inputs.name: task_inputs
required_inputs.description: approved facts and intended message; audiences and channels; decision owner, confidentiality and timing

expected_outputs.name: work_product
expected_outputs.description: message drafts; sequencing and FAQ; review/delivery plan

forbidden_actions: Unapproved payments, filings, postings, signatures, purchases, external announcements or production changes
Inventing source facts, approval or canon
verification_steps: Capture what is changing, change type/magnitude, honest reason, effective date, reversibility and decision status. Identify materially affected versus merely informed audiences, impact, constraints, embargo/legal sensitivity and a named question owner.

Use current LiNKbrain company/brand guidance and recipient preferences. Select channels by urgency, complexity, audience, sensitivity, two-way discussion and durable record needs; do not assume every audience reads the same channel.

Plan impact-then-influence sequencing and manager enablement with talk track/FAQ before broad release when needed. Respect a verified embargo/disclosure constraint that requires simultaneous release. Assign owner/channel/date to every planned touchpoint relative to the actual effective date.

Prepare the relevant audience-specific pre-communication, announcement, FAQ and follow-up drafts. State what, why, who, action/deadline or no action, where to ask and next step; do not request feedback on a settled decision as if it can change.

Audit clarity, reading difficulty, jargon, hedging, tone appropriate to magnitude, accessibility, channel fit and factual consistency. Keep touchpoint counts contextual. Read back stored drafts and route required approval; this task does not authorize sending.
completion_criteria: Task output meets contract and task-specific acceptance criteria
Sources, uncertainty, exact completion scope and remaining decisions visible
Any authorized draft write read back
known_limitations: Structural qualification does not prove every behavior
Source originals are provenance; canonical method owns execution
Specialist content/draft access may be Sara-mediated

telemetry.retention_policy: retain opaque task/source ids and hashes only
